notes.text: CSV files for finance use ';' as the delimiter and snake_case headers (invoice_id, customer, issued_on, total_cents). Finance opens them in Excel with a French locale. monthly.js predates this; don't copy its format.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: Machine-readable exports carry amounts as integer cents (total_cents: 123450), never formatMoney strings. formatMoney is for the UI only; this was corrected in review twice.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Dates in exports go through toISODate (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). formatDate depends on the server's locale and time zone and is for the UI only.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: New modules use named exports only. The default exports in older files like this one are legacy and are being removed.
notes.author: claude-code
